entrances.entrance_line: Fear not, darlings—Gloria Hex Machina came with miracles, motherboards, and a money shot.
Ladies and gentlemen, make way for Countess Neon Lace—polished, prickly, and brighter than your electric dreams!
Blessed be the circuits, sinners; Ophelia Overclock has logged in to absolve your fashions, reboot your edges, and crash this competition.
Hope you paid your Wi-Fi bill, darlings—because tonight, salvation’s downloading in high definition.
Hallelujah, honey—if you can’t handle the glow, get out the pews!
Darlings, dim the house lights—Opaline Riot is here to make your standards look underdressed.
The miracle has arrived, and unfortunately for you, she brought receipts.
Court is now in session, and mercy has never looked this guilty.
The lights didn't flicker, sweethearts—I just arrived with the whole power grid.
